summary: After a near-silent week the chat woke up on Aug 13 when Paige hit an Instagram account problem and tagged Vivek with two screenshots and 'please help'. What followed was a 44-message, ~19-hour recovery attempt that was still unfinished at the end of the window. Vivek asked for the login 'in dm' but then ran the entire recovery in the group chat anyway: Paige posted her email + password in plain text (twice), a 2FA code, her personal phone number and an account backup code, all in the client group. This is the second time in three weeks her credentials have been pasted into this chat. Vivek also briefly asked her to approve a login for an account that isn't hers ('Unfilteredlifiting'), which spooked her ('what the hell hold on'). He got in on Aug 14 and said 'Will update shortly', then when she confirmed the account state 4 hours later his final message of the week was 'Hell nah' — no explanation, and the issue is open going into next week. Separately, Derrek's Aug 1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the phone-farm/IG rollout has now gone two full weeks with nothing posted, and Michelle's content-upload asks and Mica's 1-on-1 call remain unconfirmed since early July. Payments are the one clean area: no invoice was due in this window and the last one was paid early.
